Card Q&A.q: While I have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name and my opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, can I use an effect that digivolves my Digimon to digivolve my [Gabumon] in the battle area into this card in my hand?

Effect: While you have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name and your opponent has a 10000 DP or higher Digimon, any of your [Gabumon] can digivolve into this card in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[When Digivolving] 3 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, it may unsuspend.
